# Inertia index page

<!-- Generated by php artisan standards:install from tey/standards; do not edit. -->

A CRUDDY index controller passes a typed ViewModel to resources/js/pages/<Area>/Index/Page.vue.

Scaffold: `php artisan standards:make page --flavor=index <Name>`.

Kit: @kit/ui Page, @kit/ui SectionHeader, @kit/ui DataTable, @kit/ui Placeholder.
- `Page` from `@kit/ui` for the page shell: Wraps the whole page with title and breadcrumbs (props: title).
- `SectionHeader` from `@kit/ui` for the header: Title plus the primary add action (props: title, actions slot).
- `Toolbar` from `@kit/ui` for the filters: Search and filters above the table (props: v-model filters).
- `DataTable` from `@kit/ui` for the rows: The record list (props: rows, columns).
- `RowActions` from `@kit/ui` for the row menu: Per-row actions, never navigation (props: actions descriptors).
- `Placeholder` from `@kit/ui` for the empty state: Shown when there are no rows (props: title, description).
Checks: 20, 21, descriptors, js-imports. Run `php artisan standards:check --changed` before committing.

Not sure this is the right leaf? It answers "Does the list need sorting, filters, row actions or reordering?" Call bakery.find, or run `php artisan standards:pattern --recipe=ui-page.index` to see its siblings.
